append.description: If true, append to existing file; if false, create new file

auto_3d_body.description: If true, footprints with pads but no STEP model and no component body get a placeholder extruded 3D body (1.0 mm tall, flagged assumed_height). Default false: nothing is added unless you ask, since many footprints (fiducials, test points, mounting holes) legitimately have no body. Prefer supplying real heights via component_bodies.

filepath.description: Path to the .PcbLib file to create/modify

component_index.description: Component index into the board component list (common header; -1 = free primitive). Normally omitted; preserved on a read-modify-write. Default: -1

flags.description: Primitive flags (optional). Accepts the name string read_pcblib emits (e.g. "LOCKED" or "LOCKED | KEEPOUT") or a raw bitmask integer (1=locked, 2=polygon, 4=keepout, 8=tenting-top, 16=tenting-bottom, 32=testpoint-top, 64=testpoint-bottom). Default: none

layer.description: Layer name: Top Overlay, Top Assembly, Mechanical 1, etc.

net_index.description: Net index into the board net list (common header, 0-65534; 65535 = no net). Normally omitted for library footprints; preserved on a read-modify-write. Default: 65535

polygon_index.description: Polygon index (common header; 65535 = none). Normally omitted; preserved on a read-modify-write. Default: 65535

solder_mask_expansion.description: Solder mask expansion override in mm (optional; omit to use the rule default)

unique_id.description: 8-char Altium unique ID; preserved on read-modify-write, auto-generated if omitted

component_bodies.description: Generic extruded 3D bodies (no STEP file). Each is an extruded shape defined by an outline + heights, useful for giving parts a 3D height when no STEP model is available.

additional_parameters.description: Unmodelled body parameter keys captured verbatim on read — anything the block carries that this tool has no typed field for (e.g. keys a newer Altium version writes). Each entry is a [key, value] string pair. Round-tripped so a read-modify-write does not drop keys the tool does not model. Normally omitted; supply only the pairs read_pcblib returned.

body_color_3d.description: 3D body colour as decimal RGB (Altium BODYCOLOR3D). Default: 8421504 (0x808080, grey)

cavity_height.description: Cavity depth in mm for a body embedded into a board cavity. Default: 0

component_index.description: Component index into the board component list (common header; -1 = free primitive). Normally omitted; preserved on a read-modify-write. Default: -1

embedded.description: Whether the model is embedded in the library (Altium MODEL.EMBED). Default: false

is_shape_based.description: Altium ISSHAPEBASED (shape-based vs. model-based body). Default: false

model_2d_rotation.description: 2D placement rotation in degrees (Altium MODEL.2D.ROTATION). Default: 0

model_2d_x.description: Model offset from the body origin in the 2D plane, X in mm (Altium MODEL.2D.X). Default: 0

model_2d_y.description: Model offset in the 2D plane, Y in mm (Altium MODEL.2D.Y). Default: 0

model_checksum.description: Altium MODEL.CHECKSUM; normally omitted (defaults to 0). Preserved verbatim on a read-modify-write round-trip.

model_id.description: Model GUID referencing an embedded model (Altium MODELID). Default: "" (none)

model_name.description: Model filename or external path (Altium MODEL.NAME). Default: "" (none)

name.description: Altium NAME. Default: " " (a single space, as template-default bodies emit).

net_index.description: Net index into the board net list (common header, 0-65534; 65535 = no net). Normally omitted for library footprints; preserved on a read-modify-write. Default: 65535

outline.description: Optional 2D outline polygon as {x,y} vertices in mm. If omitted, a bounding box is auto-generated from the footprint pads.

overall_height.description: Total body height above the board, in mm (top of extrusion)

polygon_index.description: Polygon index (common header; 65535 = none). Normally omitted; preserved on a read-modify-write. Default: 65535

standoff_height.description: Standoff from the board to the bottom of the body, in mm. Default: 0

sub_poly_index.description: Altium SUBPOLYINDEX; -1 when not a polygon sub-shape. Default: -1

union_index.description: Altium UNIONINDEX for grouped primitives. Default: 0

unique_id.description: 8-char Altium unique ID; preserved on read-modify-write, auto-generated if omitted

fills.description: Filled rectangle definitions (solid copper/keepout fill defined by two opposite corners).

component_index.description: Component index into the board component list (common header; -1 = free primitive). Normally omitted; preserved on a read-modify-write. Default: -1

flags.description: Primitive flags (optional). Accepts the name string read_pcblib emits (e.g. "LOCKED" or "LOCKED | KEEPOUT") or a raw bitmask integer (1=locked, 2=polygon, 4=keepout, 8=tenting-top, 16=tenting-bottom, 32=testpoint-top, 64=testpoint-bottom). Default: none

layer.description: Layer name (default Top Layer): Top Layer, Bottom Layer, Top Overlay, Mechanical 1, etc.

polygon_index.description: Polygon index (common header; 65535 = none). Normally omitted; preserved on a read-modify-write. Default: 65535

solder_mask_expansion.description: Solder mask expansion override in mm (optional; omit to use the rule default)

unique_id.description: 8-char Altium unique ID; preserved on read-modify-write, auto-generated if omitted

model_3d.description: Alternative spelling of the same 3D-model reference, matching read_pcblib's output shape so a read result replays into write_pcblib unchanged. Ignored when 'step_model' is also given; null is accepted and ignored.

filepath.description: Path to a .step file (embedded at save when it exists on disk) or a bare model name (kept as a reference)

component_index.description: Component index into the board component list (common header; -1 = free primitive). Normally omitted; preserved on a read-modify-write. Default: -1

corner_radius_percent.description: Rounded-rectangle corner radius as a percentage of the shorter side (0-100). Default: 0

flags.description: Primitive flags (optional). Accepts the name string read_pcblib emits (e.g. "LOCKED" or "LOCKED | KEEPOUT") or a raw bitmask integer (1=locked, 2=polygon, 4=keepout, 8=tenting-top, 16=tenting-bottom, 32=testpoint-top, 64=testpoint-bottom). Default: none

hole_negative_tolerance.description: Negative drill tolerance in mm (optional; omit to leave unset)

hole_positive_tolerance.description: Positive drill tolerance in mm (optional; omit to leave unset)

hole_rotation.description: Hole rotation in degrees (rotates a slot hole). Default: 0

hole_shape.description: Drill hole shape. Default: round. Use slot for oblong holes (set hole_slot_length)

hole_slot_length.description: Slot length in mm for a slot hole (hole_shape=slot). Default: 0

identity_guid.description: Per-pad identity GUID (braced string, e.g. "{A5172B29-...}"); preserved verbatim on read-modify-write, freshly generated if omitted

identity_guid_b.description: Pad-stack/footprint-scoped identity GUID (braced string); preserved verbatim on read-modify-write, freshly generated if omitted

is_plated.description: Whether the hole is plated. Altium stores this for every pad (SMD included). Default: true

jumper_id.description: Jumper group id. Pads sharing a non-zero id are linked as a jumper / 0-ohm net. Default: 0

layer.description: Layer name: Top Layer, Bottom Layer, Multi-Layer (default for SMD)

net_index.description: Net index into the board net list (common header, 0-65534; 65535 = no net). Normally omitted for library footprints; preserved on a read-modify-write. Default: 65535

paste_mask_expansion.description: Paste (stencil) mask expansion in mm (optional; omit to use the rule default)

paste_mask_expansion_mode.description: Paste mask expansion mode. 'none' (the default) leaves the cached value stale so Altium takes the expansion from the design rule; 'from_rule' tells Altium the stored value is a rule result to honour as-is; 'manual' uses the stored value as hand-specified.

per_layer_corner_radii.description: Per-layer corner radius as a percentage (0-100), for rounded-rectangle layers.

per_layer_offsets.description: Per-layer pad offsets in mm from the pad centre.

per_layer_shapes.description: Per-layer pad shapes, same ordering and count as per_layer_sizes.

per_layer_sizes.description: Per-layer pad sizes in mm, used when stack_mode is not "simple". Entry count must match the stack mode (3 or 32).

polygon_index.description: Polygon index (common header; 65535 = none). Normally omitted; preserved on a read-modify-write. Default: 65535

power_plane_clearance.description: Power-plane (anti-pad) clearance to the plane in mm. Default: 0.508 (20 mil)

power_plane_connect_style.description: How the pad connects to an internal power plane. Default: relief (thermal spokes)

power_plane_relief_expansion.description: Power-plane relief expansion in mm. Default: 0.508 (20 mil)

relief_air_gap.description: Thermal-relief air-gap width in mm. Default: 0.254 (10 mil)

relief_conductor_width.description: Thermal-relief spoke (conductor) width in mm. Default: 0.254 (10 mil)

shape.description: Pad shape. Omitting this field yields rounded_rectangle, which suits chip/QFN lands but is WRONG for BGA/CSP: circular NSMD BGA lands must set "round" explicitly. rectangle is conventional for pin 1; round/circle are equivalent and used for both BGA lands and through-hole pads; also oval, octagonal. Matching is case-insensitive and ignores '_'/'-'.

solder_mask_expansion.description: Solder mask expansion in mm (optional; omit to use the rule default)

solder_mask_expansion_from_hole_edge.description: Measure solder-mask expansion from the HOLE edge instead of the pad edge. Only meaningful on a pad with a hole. Default: false

solder_mask_expansion_mode.description: Solder mask expansion mode. 'none' (the default) leaves the cached value stale so Altium takes the expansion from the design rule; 'from_rule' tells Altium the stored value is a rule result to honour as-is; 'manual' uses the stored value as hand-specified.

stack_mode.description: Per-layer pad stack. "simple" (default) uses one size and shape on every layer; "top_middle_bottom" takes 3 per-layer entries [top, mid, bottom]; "full_stack" takes 32 (index 0 = Top, 1 = Bottom, 2-31 = Mid layers).

unique_id.description: 8-char Altium unique ID; preserved on read-modify-write, auto-generated if omitted

regions.description: Filled region definitions (courtyard, copper pour, cutout, etc.)

Round-tripped so a read-modify-write does not drop keys the tool does not model. Normally omitted; supply only the pairs read_pcblib returned.

arc_resolution.description: Altium ARCRESOLUTION (arc-to-line tolerance, optional). Normally omitted; preserved on a read-modify-write. Default: 0

cavity_height.description: Cavity height in mm for embedded components (optional). Default: 0

holes.description: Interior hole/cutout contours (optional). Each hole is an array of {x,y} vertices subtracted from the outline.

is_shape_based.description: Altium ISSHAPEBASED. Preserved on a read-modify-write. Default: false

kind.description: Region kind (optional). "copper" (default) for a copper pour/fill, "cutout" for a board/polygon cutout, or a raw Altium KIND integer. Default: copper

is_comment.description: Mark this text as the component's Comment field (Altium IsComment). Preserved on read-modify-write. Default: false
